messages:
marta: Heads-up: nightly usage agg created negative 'usage_offset' rows and Stripe credits were issued, but NetSuite apply step failed and left pending credit memos for ~10 accounts.

samir: any example ids or job id?

marta: job billing.post_usage_aggregate/2026-03-24T03:00Z. sample: acct_1257 amount -12.34 created 2026-03-24T03:01Z

fin-bot: NetSuite sync failed: credit_memo 11022 apply -> 422 Unprocessable Entity: "applyAmount must be > 0" (attempts=3).

elaine: likely a sign inversion introduced with last week's usage_offset change. @samir can you check mapper?

samir: found it: mapper negates for offsets then later normalizer also flips sign. double-negation. patch ready to remove extra negation + unit test. will add idempotency token to payloads.

ops-jen: recommend pausing NetSuite apply step to avoid more pending memos. need finance OK.

marta: +1 to pause.

tom: accounting approves pause; we'll reconcile pending memos after fix.

ops-jen: NS_SYNC_APPLY=false set for tonight.

samir: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/805 includes fix + tests + migration for ns_idempotency_key. deploying to staging now.

fin-bot: deploy event -> billing-service v2.14.5 to staging started.

marta: plan for remediation: re-run apply with corrected payloads (keep credit_memos) and mark as applied once accepted by NetSuite. create FIN-439 with affected accounts.

elaine: +1. ensure backfill is single-run and guarded by idempotency.

marta: will update FIN-439 and close thread after reconciliation. :white_check_mark:
